label: 🧭 Convert coordinates
description: Lossless conversion between polar, Cartesian, and geographic coordinate systems. Pure trig for polar↔Cartesian; WGS84 ellipsoid math for geographic↔Cartesian (ECEF).

fromType.label: Source coordinate system
fromType.help: What system the source columns express. cartesian: (x, y[, z]); polar: (r, θ[, φ]) with θ/φ in radians; geographic: (lat, lon) in degrees.

toType.label: Target coordinate system
toType.help: What system to produce. polar↔cartesian conversions are dimension-preserving (2D↔2D, 3D↔3D). geographic↔cartesian uses ECEF (Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed) on the WGS84 ellipsoid; output is 3D.

sourceColumns.label: Source columns
sourceColumns.help: The columns carrying the source coordinates, in canonical order: cartesian: [x, y, z?]; polar: [r, theta, phi?]; geographic: [lat, lon].

outputPrefix.label: Output column prefix
outputPrefix.help: Prepended to each generated output column name. Output names follow the canonical order of the target system: cartesian → x/y[/z]; polar → r/theta[/phi]; geographic → lat/lon.
